annotations.title: Has this launch lifted the brand it came from?

description: Use when the user asks whether a line extension, spin-off, sequel, collaboration or new product lifted interest in the parent brand or show, or is weighing a launch on the promise of a halo. Returns, for the launch month, the parent's US search change against the three months before, the best same-window change in every other year since 2019 as a seasonal control, and a verdict against a +20% bar set before the pull: lifted, seasonal, or no lift; optionally English Wikipedia as a second signal. Ratios only. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. Dimensions (vary these inputs to cut the answer; each call is its own run): over time: built in: the launch month against the same window in other years. Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound.

article.description: Optional: the English Wikipedia article on the parent, e.g. "Power (TV series)".

parent.description: The parent brand or show as people search for it, e.g. "power" or "oreo".
